query: SELECT d."projectId" AS project_id, status_ep.values AS status_values, depends_ep.values AS depends_values FROM "Document" d JOIN document_sub_type dst ON dst.document_id=d.id AND dst.sub_type='task' LEFT JOIN entity_properties status_ep ON status_ep.entity_id=d.id AND status_ep.entity_type='TASK' AND status_ep.property_definition_id=$2 LEFT JOIN entity_properties depends_ep ON depends_ep.entity_id=d.id AND depends_ep.entity_type='TASK' AND depends_ep.property_definition_id=$3 WHERE d.id=$1 AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF d
